span.p:
Can you staff two or more analysts
per shift, every shift, year-round, today?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Is telemetry too sensitive for third-party
raw access -- regulatory, IP, litigation hold?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Does overnight/weekend volume justify
full in-house staffing for those shifts too?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Co-managed:
in-house tiers, vendor overflow
only on lower-sensitivity telemetry

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Can you justify two or more FTE
on detection engineering, not generalist triage?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Hybrid:
outsourced 24/7 monitoring +
embedded detection engineering
